summary: Park-side kerb on Macquarie Street where cars already park nose to tail.
reasons: Many cars parked along this kerb
Houses only across the road, 20 m

best_section.where: North kerb of Macquarie Street along the park, west of the road markings

drivers.seclusion: Open park lawn and trees on the van's side; the nearest dwellings are across the road about 20 m away and others 31 m and further.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed kerb on a wide street with a parking lane; a van fits in line with the parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Moderate local street traffic; parked cars separate the van from the lane.
drivers.convention: A continuous line of cars parks along this kerb in both images, so a van would blend in.

flags: Signs vary along the street: 2P resident-permit weekdays 7am-6pm, No Stopping and a passenger loading zone, with some P (No Limit)
Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, Brisbane River 229 m away
Avalon Theatre 39 m away may mean evening events
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun, with a few trees shading parts of the kerb from the north.
cannot_judge: Which sign applies at the exact spot
